name: Tanimura Hina
source:
Best friend/mother/daughter/sister of the protagonist (depending on what cheats are or aren't used). Can also be a catgirl, cowgirl, pirate or a combination of the three depending on what cheats are activated.

[spoiler]If she is [url=https://vndb.org/c62195]Minorou[/url]'s sister, she's a virgin because she fell for her brother several years ago when Minorou, [url=https://vndb.org/c62192]Hatsune[/url] and her had played the "bottle's game" where Minorou had to kiss her and touch her chest as a pledge.[/spoiler]
